"""Utilities for appending ports and pins to Verilog files."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union


ENCODING = "utf-8"


def _try_import_pyslang():
    try:
        return importlib.import_module("pyslang")
    except Exception:
        return None


def read_file_text(path: Path) -> str:
    """Read file with standard encoding."""
    return path.read_text(encoding=ENCODING)


def write_file_text(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
    """Write file with standard encoding and newline."""
    path.write_text(content + "\n", encoding=ENCODING)


def _apply_text_edits(text: str, edits: List[Tuple[int, int, str]]) -> str:
    if not edits:
        return text
    ordered = sorted(edits, key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]), reverse=True)
    updated = text
    for start, end, replacement in ordered:
        if start < 0 or end < start or end > len(updated):
            raise ValueError("Invalid text edit range")
        updated = updated[:start] + replacement + updated[end:]
    return updated


def _split_top_level_commas(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Split a block on top-level commas while preserving bracketed expressions."""
    parts: List[str] = []
    current: List[str] = []
    paren_depth = 0
    bracket_depth = 0
    brace_depth = 0

    for char in text:
        if char == "(" :
            paren_depth += 1
        elif char == ")" and paren_depth > 0:
            paren_depth -= 1
        elif char == "[":
            bracket_depth += 1
        elif char == "]" and bracket_depth > 0:
            bracket_depth -= 1
        elif char == "{":
            brace_depth += 1
        elif char == "}" and brace_depth > 0:
            brace_depth -= 1

        if char == "," and paren_depth == 0 and bracket_depth == 0 and brace_depth == 0:
            part = "".join(current).strip()
            if part:
                parts.append(part)
            current = []
            continue

        current.append(char)

    tail = "".join(current).strip()
    if tail:
        parts.append(tail)
    return parts


def _find_matching_paren(text: str, open_idx: int) -> int:
    depth = 0
    for idx in range(open_idx, len(text)):
        char = text[idx]
        if char == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif char == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return idx
    return -1


def _locate_module_interface(text: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, int]]]:
    module_match = re.search(r"\bmodule\s+([`\w$]+)", text)
    if not module_match:
        return None

    module_name = module_match.group(1)
    module_start = module_match.start()
    scan_idx = module_match.end()

    while True:
        scan_idx = len(text) if scan_idx >= len(text) else scan_idx
        scan_idx = len(text) if scan_idx < 0 else scan_idx
        scan_idx = scan_idx if scan_idx < len(text) else len(text)
        while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
            scan_idx += 1

        if text.startswith("import", scan_idx):
            semi_idx = text.find(";", scan_idx)
            if semi_idx < 0:
                return None
            scan_idx = semi_idx + 1
            continue
        break

    if scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx] == "#":
        hash_open = text.find("(", scan_idx)
        if hash_open < 0:
            return None
        hash_close = _find_matching_paren(text, hash_open)
        if hash_close < 0:
            return None
        scan_idx = hash_close + 1
        while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
            scan_idx += 1
        while text.startswith("import", scan_idx):
            semi_idx = text.find(";", scan_idx)
            if semi_idx < 0:
                return None
            scan_idx = semi_idx + 1
            while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
                scan_idx += 1

    open_idx = text.find("(", scan_idx)
    if open_idx < 0:
        return None

    close_idx = _find_matching_paren(text, open_idx)
    if close_idx < 0:
        return None

    semi_idx = text.find(";", close_idx)
    if semi_idx < 0:
        return None

    return {
        "module_name": module_name,
        "module_start": module_start,
        "module_open": open_idx,
        "module_close": close_idx,
        "module_semi": semi_idx,
        "port_block": text[open_idx + 1 : close_idx],
    }


def _locate_instantiation_block(text: str, inst_name: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, int]]]:
    inst_match = re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(inst_name)}\b\s*\(", text)
    if not inst_match:
        return None

    inst_start = inst_match.start()
    open_idx = text.find("(", inst_match.start())
    if open_idx < 0:
        return None
    close_idx = _find_matching_paren(text, open_idx)
    if close_idx < 0:
        return None
    return {
        "inst_start": inst_start,
        "inst_open": open_idx,
        "inst_close": close_idx,
        "conn_block": text[open_idx + 1 : close_idx],
    }


def _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_entry: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Parse one ANSI-style port declaration into name, direction, and width."""
    cleaned_entry = re.sub(r"//.*", "", port_entry).strip()
    cleaned_entry = re.sub(r"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", "", cleaned_entry).strip()
    if not cleaned_entry:
        return None

    direction_match = re.match(r"^(input|output|inout)\b", cleaned_entry)
    if not direction_match:
        return None

    direction = direction_match.group(1)
    identifiers = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*", cleaned_entry)
    if not identifiers:
        return None

    name = identifiers[-1]
    width_matches = re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]", cleaned_entry)
    width = " ".join(width_matches)
    return {
        "name": name,
        "direction": direction,
        "width": width,
    }


def parse_ansi_module_interface(file_path: Path) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Parse module name and ANSI-style port declarations from a Verilog/SystemVerilog file."""
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return None

    text = read_file_text(file_path)
    located = _locate_module_interface(text)
    if not located:
        return None

    module_name = str(located["module_name"])
    port_block = str(located["port_block"])
    port_entries = _split_top_level_commas(port_block)
    ports = []
    for port_entry in port_entries:
        parsed_entry = _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_entry)
        if parsed_entry:
            ports.append(parsed_entry)

    return {
        "module_name": module_name,
        "ports": ports,
    }


def append_port(file_path: Path, signals: List[Union[Dict, Tuple, str]], c_like: bool = True) -> bool:
    """
    Append signals to module port list with optional direction and width.
    
    Supports two styles:
    
    1. C-style (c_like=True, default):
       Appends full declarations in the module port list:
       ,input [5:0] sys_link_capable
    
    2. Verilog-style (c_like=False):
       Appends signal names in port list: ,signal_name
       Then appends full declarations after the last signal in the declarations section:
       input [5:0] signal_name;
    
    Supports multiple input formats for signals:
    - dict: {"name": "signal_name", "direction": "input", "width": "[2:0]"}
           (direction and width are optional)
    - tuple: ("signal_name", "input", "[2:0]") or ("signal_name", "input")
    - str: "signal_name" (simple signal without direction/width)
    
    Args:
        file_path: Path to the file to modify
        signals: List of signal specifications
        c_like: If True (default), use C-style port declarations in module header.
                If False, use Verilog-style port names in header + declarations after last signal.
    
    Returns True if modification was made, False otherwise.
    """
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return False
    
    text = read_file_text(file_path)

"""Utilities for appending ports and pins to Verilog files."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union


ENCODING = "utf-8"


def _try_import_pyslang():
    try:
        return importlib.import_module("pyslang")
    except Exception:
        return None


def read_file_text(path: Path) -> str:
    """Read file with standard encoding."""
    return path.read_text(encoding=ENCODING)


def write_file_text(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
    """Write file with standard encoding and newline."""
    path.write_text(content + "\n", encoding=ENCODING)


def _apply_text_edits(text: str, edits: List[Tuple[int, int, str]]) -> str:
    if not edits:
        return text
    ordered = sorted(edits, key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]), reverse=True)
    updated = text
    for start, end, replacement in ordered:
        if start < 0 or end < start or end > len(updated):
            raise ValueError("Invalid text edit range")
        updated = updated[:start] + replacement + updated[end:]
    return updated


def _split_top_level_commas(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Split a block on top-level commas while preserving bracketed expressions."""
    parts: List[str] = []
    current: List[str] = []
    paren_depth = 0
    bracket_depth = 0
    brace_depth = 0

    for char in text:
        if char == "(" :
            paren_depth += 1
        elif char == ")" and paren_depth > 0:
            paren_depth -= 1
        elif char == "[":
            bracket_depth += 1
        elif char == "]" and bracket_depth > 0:
            bracket_depth -= 1
        elif char == "{":
            brace_depth += 1
        elif char == "}" and brace_depth > 0:
            brace_depth -= 1

        if char == "," and paren_depth == 0 and bracket_depth == 0 and brace_depth == 0:
            part = "".join(current).strip()
            if part:
                parts.append(part)
            current = []
            continue

        current.append(char)

    tail = "".join(current).strip()
    if tail:
        parts.append(tail)
    return parts


def _find_matching_paren(text: str, open_idx: int) -> int:
    depth = 0
    for idx in range(open_idx, len(text)):
        char = text[idx]
        if char == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif char == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return idx
    return -1


def _locate_module_interface(text: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, int]]]:
    module_match = re.search(r"\bmodule\s+([`\w$]+)", text)
    if not module_match:
        return None

    module_name = module_match.group(1)
    module_start = module_match.start()
    scan_idx = module_match.end()

    while True:
        scan_idx = len(text) if scan_idx >= len(text) else scan_idx
        scan_idx = len(text) if scan_idx < 0 else scan_idx
        scan_idx = scan_idx if scan_idx < len(text) else len(text)
        while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
            scan_idx += 1

        if text.startswith("import", scan_idx):
            semi_idx = text.find(";", scan_idx)
            if semi_idx < 0:
                return None
            scan_idx = semi_idx + 1
            continue
        break

    if scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx] == "#":
        hash_open = text.find("(", scan_idx)
        if hash_open < 0:
            return None
        hash_close = _find_matching_paren(text, hash_open)
        if hash_close < 0:
            return None
        scan_idx = hash_close + 1
        while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
            scan_idx += 1
        while text.startswith("import", scan_idx):
            semi_idx = text.find(";", scan_idx)
            if semi_idx < 0:
                return None
            scan_idx = semi_idx + 1
            while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
                scan_idx += 1

    open_idx = text.find("(", scan_idx)
    if open_idx < 0:
        return None

    close_idx = _find_matching_paren(text, open_idx)
    if close_idx < 0:
        return None

    semi_idx = text.find(";", close_idx)
    if semi_idx < 0:
        return None

    return {
        "module_name": module_name,
        "module_start": module_start,
        "module_open": open_idx,
        "module_close": close_idx,
        "module_semi": semi_idx,
        "port_block": text[open_idx + 1 : close_idx],
    }


def _locate_instantiation_block(text: str, inst_name: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, int]]]:
    inst_match = re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(inst_name)}\b\s*\(", text)
    if not inst_match:
        return None

    inst_start = inst_match.start()
    open_idx = text.find("(", inst_match.start())
    if open_idx < 0:
        return None
    close_idx = _find_matching_paren(text, open_idx)
    if close_idx < 0:
        return None
    return {
        "inst_start": inst_start,
        "inst_open": open_idx,
        "inst_close": close_idx,
        "conn_block": text[open_idx + 1 : close_idx],
    }


def _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_entry: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Parse one ANSI-style port declaration into name, direction, and width."""
    cleaned_entry = re.sub(r"//.*", "", port_entry).strip()
    cleaned_entry = re.sub(r"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", "", cleaned_entry).strip()
    if not cleaned_entry:
        return None

    direction_match = re.match(r"^(input|output|inout)\b", cleaned_entry)
    if not direction_match:
        return None

    direction = direction_match.group(1)
    identifiers = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*", cleaned_entry)
    if not identifiers:
        return None

    name = identifiers[-1]
    width_matches = re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]", cleaned_entry)
    width = " ".join(width_matches)
    return {
        "name": name,
        "direction": direction,
        "width": width,
    }


def _parse_ansi_module_interface_pyslang(file_path: Path) -> Optional[Dict]:
    pyslang = _try_import_pyslang()
    if pyslang is None:
        return None

    try:
        tree = pyslang.SyntaxTree.fromFile(str(file_path))
    except Exception:
        return None

    root = getattr(tree, "root", None)
    if root is None:
        return None

    members = getattr(root, "members", None)
    if members is None:
        return None

    module = None
    for member in members:
        if isinstance(member, pyslang.ModuleDeclarationSyntax):
            module = member
            break
    if module is None:
        return None

    header = getattr(module, "header", None)
    if header is None:
        return None

    module_name_tok = getattr(header, "name", None)
    module_name = getattr(module_name_tok, "value", None) or getattr(module_name_tok, "rawText", None)
    if not module_name:
        return None

    ports_container = getattr(header, "ports", None)
    port_nodes = getattr(ports_container, "ports", None) if ports_container is not None else None
    if port_nodes is None:
        return {"module_name": str(module_name), "ports": []}

    ports: List[Dict] = []
    for port in port_nodes:
        port_text = str(getattr(port, "rawText", "") or "").strip()
        if not port_text:
            continue
        parsed = _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_text)
        if parsed:
            ports.append(parsed)

    return {
        "module_name": str(module_name),
        "ports": ports,
    }


def parse_ansi_module_interface(file_path: Path) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Parse module name and ANSI-style port declarations from a Verilog/SystemVerilog file."""
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return None

    parsed = _parse_ansi_module_interface_pyslang(file_path)
    if parsed is not None:
        return parsed

    text = read_file_text(file_path)
    located = _locate_module_interface(text)
    if not located:
        return None

    module_name = str(located["module_name"])
    port_block = str(located["port_block"])
    port_entries = _split_top_level_commas(port_block)
    ports = []
    for port_entry in port_entries:
        parsed_entry = _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_entry)
        if parsed_entry:
            ports.append(parsed_entry)

    return {
        "module_name": module_name,
        "ports": ports,
    }

    new_text = text[:inst_start] + replacement
    write_file_text(file_path, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return True

"""Utilities for appending ports and pins to Verilog files."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union


ENCODING = "utf-8"


def _try_import_pyslang():
    try:
        return importlib.import_module("pyslang")
    except Exception:
        return None


def read_file_text(path: Path) -> str:
    """Read file with standard encoding."""
    return path.read_text(encoding=ENCODING)


def write_file_text(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
    """Write file with standard encoding and newline."""
    path.write_text(content + "\n", encoding=ENCODING)


def _apply_text_edits(text: str, edits: List[Tuple[int, int, str]]) -> str:
    if not edits:
        return text
    ordered = sorted(edits, key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]), reverse=True)
    updated = text
    for start, end, replacement in ordered:
        if start < 0 or end < start or end > len(updated):
            raise ValueError("Invalid text edit range")
        updated = updated[:start] + replacement + updated[end:]
    return updated


def _split_top_level_commas(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Split a block on top-level commas while preserving bracketed expressions."""
    parts: List[str] = []
    current: List[str] = []
    paren_depth = 0
    bracket_depth = 0
    brace_depth = 0

    for char in text:
        if char == "(" :
            paren_depth += 1
        elif char == ")" and paren_depth > 0:
            paren_depth -= 1
        elif char == "[":
            bracket_depth += 1
        elif char == "]" and bracket_depth > 0:
            bracket_depth -= 1
        elif char == "{":
            brace_depth += 1
        elif char == "}" and brace_depth > 0:
            brace_depth -= 1

        if char == "," and paren_depth == 0 and bracket_depth == 0 and brace_depth == 0:
            part = "".join(current).strip()
            if part:
                parts.append(part)
            current = []
            continue

        current.append(char)

    tail = "".join(current).strip()
    if tail:
        parts.append(tail)
    return parts


def _find_matching_paren(text: str, open_idx: int) -> int:
    depth = 0
    for idx in range(open_idx, len(text)):
        char = text[idx]
        if char == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif char == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return idx
    return -1


def _locate_module_interface(text: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, int]]]:
    module_match = re.search(r"\bmodule\s+([`\w$]+)", text)
    if not module_match:
        return None

    module_name = module_match.group(1)
    module_start = module_match.start()
    scan_idx = module_match.end()

    while True:
        scan_idx = len(text) if scan_idx >= len(text) else scan_idx
        scan_idx = len(text) if scan_idx < 0 else scan_idx
        scan_idx = scan_idx if scan_idx < len(text) else len(text)
        while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
            scan_idx += 1

        if text.startswith("import", scan_idx):
            semi_idx = text.find(";", scan_idx)
            if semi_idx < 0:
                return None
            scan_idx = semi_idx + 1
            continue
        break

    if scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx] == "#":
        hash_open = text.find("(", scan_idx)
        if hash_open < 0:
            return None
        hash_close = _find_matching_paren(text, hash_open)
        if hash_close < 0:
            return None
        scan_idx = hash_close + 1
        while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
            scan_idx += 1
        while text.startswith("import", scan_idx):
            semi_idx = text.find(";", scan_idx)
            if semi_idx < 0:
                return None
            scan_idx = semi_idx + 1
            while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
                scan_idx += 1

    open_idx = text.find("(", scan_idx)
    if open_idx < 0:
        return None

    close_idx = _find_matching_paren(text, open_idx)
    if close_idx < 0:
        return None

    semi_idx = text.find(";", close_idx)
    if semi_idx < 0:
        return None

    return {
        "module_name": module_name,
        "module_start": module_start,
        "module_open": open_idx,
        "module_close": close_idx,
        "module_semi": semi_idx,
        "port_block": text[open_idx + 1 : close_idx],
    }


def _locate_instantiation_block(text: str, inst_name: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, int]]]:
    inst_match = re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(inst_name)}\b\s*\(", text)
    if not inst_match:
        return None

    inst_start = inst_match.start()
    open_idx = text.find("(", inst_match.start())
    if open_idx < 0:
        return None
    close_idx = _find_matching_paren(text, open_idx)
    if close_idx < 0:
        return None
    return {
        "inst_start": inst_start,
        "inst_open": open_idx,
        "inst_close": close_idx,
        "conn_block": text[open_idx + 1 : close_idx],
    }


def _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_entry: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Parse one ANSI-style port declaration into name, direction, and width."""
    cleaned_entry = re.sub(r"//.*", "", port_entry).strip()
    cleaned_entry = re.sub(r"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", "", cleaned_entry).strip()
    if not cleaned_entry:
        return None

    direction_match = re.match(r"^(input|output|inout)\b", cleaned_entry)
    if not direction_match:
        return None

    direction = direction_match.group(1)
    identifiers = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*", cleaned_entry)
    if not identifiers:
        return None

    name = identifiers[-1]
    width_matches = re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]", cleaned_entry)
    width = " ".join(width_matches)
    return {
        "name": name,
        "direction": direction,
        "width": width,
    }


def _parse_ansi_module_interface_pyslang(file_path: Path) -> Optional[Dict]:
    pyslang = _try_import_pyslang()
    if pyslang is None:
        return None

    try:
        tree = pyslang.SyntaxTree.fromFile(str(file_path))
    except Exception:
        return None

    root = getattr(tree, "root", None)
    if root is None:
        return None

    members = getattr(root, "members", None)
    if members is None:
        return None

    module = None
    for member in members:
        if isinstance(member, pyslang.ModuleDeclarationSyntax):
            module = member
            break
    if module is None:
        return None

    header = getattr(module, "header", None)
    if header is None:
        return None

    module_name_tok = getattr(header, "name", None)
    module_name = getattr(module_name_tok, "value", None) or getattr(module_name_tok, "rawText", None)
    if not module_name:
        return None

    ports_container = getattr(header, "ports", None)
    port_nodes = getattr(ports_container, "ports", None) if ports_container is not None else None
    if port_nodes is None:
        return {"module_name": str(module_name), "ports": []}

    ports: List[Dict] = []
    for port in port_nodes:
        port_text = str(getattr(port, "rawText", "") or "").strip()
        if not port_text:
            continue
        parsed = _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_text)
        if parsed:
            ports.append(parsed)

    return {
        "module_name": str(module_name),
        "ports": ports,
    }


def parse_ansi_module_interface(file_path: Path) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Parse module name and ANSI-style port declarations from a Verilog/SystemVerilog file."""
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return None

    parsed = _parse_ansi_module_interface_pyslang(file_path)
    if parsed is not None:
        return parsed

    text = read_file_text(file_path)
    located = _locate_module_interface(text)
    if not located:
        return None

    module_name = str(located["module_name"])
    port_block = str(located["port_block"])
    port_entries = _split_top_level_commas(port_block)
    ports = []
    for port_entry in port_entries:
        parsed_entry = _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_entry)
        if parsed_entry:
            ports.append(parsed_entry)

    return {
        "module_name": module_name,
        "ports": ports,
    }


def append_port(file_path: Path, signals: List[Union[Dict, Tuple, str]], c_like: bool = True) -> bool:
    """
    Append signals to module port list with optional direction and width.
    
    Supports two styles:
    
    1. C-style (c_like=True, default):
       Appends full declarations in the module port list:
       ,input [5:0] sys_link_capable
    
    2. Verilog-style (c_like=False):
       Appends signal names in port list: ,signal_name
       Then appends full declarations after the last signal in the declarations section:
       input [5:0] signal_name;
    
    Supports multiple input formats for signals:
    - dict: {"name": "signal_name", "direction": "input", "width": "[2:0]"}
           (direction and width are optional)
    - tuple: ("signal_name", "input", "[2:0]") or ("signal_name", "input")
    - str: "signal_name" (simple signal without direction/width)
    
    Args:
        file_path: Path to the file to modify
        signals: List of signal specifications
        c_like: If True (default), use C-style port declarations in module header.
                If False, use Verilog-style port names in header + declarations after last signal.
    
    Returns True if modification was made, False otherwise.
    """
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return False
    
    text = read_file_text(file_path)
    
    # Convert signals to standardized format
    signal_specs = []
    for sig in signals:
        if isinstance(sig, dict):
            name = sig.get("name")
            direction = sig.get("direction", "")
            width = sig.get("width", "")
            signal_specs.append((name, direction, width))
        elif isinstance(sig, tuple):
            if len(sig) == 3:
                signal_specs.append(sig)
            elif len(sig) == 2:
                signal_specs.append((sig[0], sig[1], ""))
            else:
                signal_specs.append((sig[0], "", ""))
        elif isinstance(sig, str):
            signal_specs.append((sig, "", ""))
    
    located = _locate_module_interface(text)
    if not located:
        return False

    module_start = int(located["module_start"])
    module_open_idx = int(located["module_open"])
    module_close_idx = int(located["module_close"])
    module_semi_idx = int(located["module_semi"])
    module_open = text[module_start : module_open_idx + 1]
    port_block = str(located["port_block"])
    module_close = text[module_close_idx : module_semi_idx + 1]

    def build_port_entry(name: str, direction: str, width: str) -> str:
        if direction and width:
            return f"{direction} {width} {name}"
        if direction:
            return f"{direction} {name}"
        if width:
            return f"{width} {name}"
        return name

    def build_decl_line(name: str, direction: str, width: str) -> str:
        if direction and width:
            return f"{direction} {width} {name};"
        if direction:
            return f"{direction} {name};"
        if width:
            return f"{width} {name};"
        return f"{name};"

    missing_specs = []
    for name, direction, width in signal_specs:
        if not name:
            continue
        if re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\b", port_block):
            continue
        missing_specs.append((name, direction, width))

    if not missing_specs:
        return False

    port_lines = port_block.splitlines()
    last_nonempty_line = next((line for line in reversed(port_lines) if line.strip()), "")
    line_indent = re.match(r"\s*", last_nonempty_line).group(0) if last_nonempty_line else ""

    if c_like:
        added_entries = [build_port_entry(name, direction, width) for name, direction, width in missing_specs]
        added_lines = [f"{line_indent},{entry}" for entry in added_entries]
        updated_ports = port_block.rstrip() + "\n" + "\n".join(added_lines)
        replacement = module_open + updated_ports + "\n" + module_close
        new_text = _apply_text_edits(text, [(module_start, module_semi_idx + 1, replacement)])
    else:
        added_names = [name for name, _, _ in missing_specs]
        added_lines = [f"{line_indent},{name}" for name in added_names]
        existing_port_lines = port_block.rstrip("\n").splitlines()
        if existing_port_lines:
            updated_port_lines = existing_port_lines + added_lines
            updated_ports = "\n".join(updated_port_lines)
        else:
            updated_ports = "\n".join(added_lines)
        replacement = module_open + updated_ports + "\n" + module_close

        existing_port_names = [
            token
            for token in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*", port_block)
        ]

        suffix = text[module_semi_idx + 1 :]
        decl_insert_rel = 0
        if existing_port_names:
            last_port_name = existing_port_names[-1]
            decl_pattern = re.compile(
                rf"^\s*(input|output|inout)\b[^\n]*\b{re.escape(last_port_name)}\b[^\n]*[;；][ \t\r]*$",
                re.MULTILINE,
            )
            decl_match = decl_pattern.search(suffix)
            if decl_match:
                decl_insert_rel = decl_match.end()

        prefix = text[:module_start]
        base_text = prefix + replacement + suffix
        insert_pos = len(prefix) + len(replacement) + decl_insert_rel

        decl_block = "\n" + "\n".join(
            build_decl_line(name, direction, width) for name, direction, width in missing_specs
        ) + "\n"
        new_text = base_text[:insert_pos] + decl_block + base_text[insert_pos:]

    write_file_text(file_path, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return True


def append_pin(file_path: Path, inst_name: str, pins: List[Tuple[str, str]]) -> bool:
    """
    Append port connections to instance instantiation, one pin per line with leading comma and dot.
    Finds "INSTNAME (...)" and adds port connections before ");".
    pins is a list of tuples like [("sys_fast_link_mode", "sys_fast_link_mode"), 
                                     ("sys_link_capable", "sys_link_capable")]
    which will be added one per line as "\n,.sys_fast_link_mode(sys_fast_link_mode)".
    Returns True if modification was made, False otherwise.
    """
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return False
    
    text = read_file_text(file_path)
    located = _locate_instantiation_block(text, inst_name)
    if not located:
        return False

    inst_start = int(located["inst_start"])
    inst_open = int(located["inst_open"])
    inst_close = int(located["inst_close"])
    conn_block = str(located["conn_block"])

    missing_pins = []
    for port_name, signal_name in pins:
        if re.search(rf"\.\s*{re.escape(port_name)}\s*\(", conn_block):
            continue
        missing_pins.append((port_name, signal_name))

    if not missing_pins:
        return False

    pin_strs = [f"{port_name}({signal_name})" for port_name, signal_name in missing_pins]
    updated_conns = conn_block.rstrip() + "\n,." + "\n,.".join(pin_strs)
    replacement = text[inst_start : inst_open + 1] + updated_conns + "\n" + text[inst_close:]
    new_text = _apply_text_edits(text, [(inst_start, len(text), replacement)])
    write_file_text(file_path, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return True


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Example usage
    import sys
    
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: module_append_utils.py <command> [options]")
        print("Commands:")
        print("  append_port <file> <signal1> [<signal2> ...] [--c-like yes|no]")
        print("  append_pin <file> <inst_name> <port1:sig1> [<port2:sig2> ...] ")
        sys.exit(1)

"""Utilities for appending ports and pins to Verilog files."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union


ENCODING = "utf-8"

"""Utilities for appending ports and pins to Verilog files."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union


ENCODING = "utf-8"
pyslang = importlib.import_module("pyslang")


def read_file_text(path: Path) -> str:
    """Read file with standard encoding."""
    return path.read_text(encoding=ENCODING)


def write_file_text(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
    """Write file with standard encoding and newline."""
    path.write_text(content + "\n", encoding=ENCODING)


def _apply_text_edits(text: str, edits: List[Tuple[int, int, str]]) -> str:
    if not edits:
        return text
    ordered = sorted(edits, key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]), reverse=True)
    updated = text
    for start, end, replacement in ordered:
        if start < 0 or end < start or end > len(updated):
            raise ValueError("Invalid text edit range")
        updated = updated[:start] + replacement + updated[end:]
    return updated


def _split_top_level_commas(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Split a block on top-level commas while preserving bracketed expressions."""
    parts: List[str] = []
    current: List[str] = []
    paren_depth = 0
    bracket_depth = 0
    brace_depth = 0

    for char in text:
        if char == "(" :
            paren_depth += 1
        elif char == ")" and paren_depth > 0:
            paren_depth -= 1
        elif char == "[":
            bracket_depth += 1
        elif char == "]" and bracket_depth > 0:
            bracket_depth -= 1
        elif char == "{":
            brace_depth += 1
        elif char == "}" and brace_depth > 0:
            brace_depth -= 1

        if char == "," and paren_depth == 0 and bracket_depth == 0 and brace_depth == 0:
            part = "".join(current).strip()
            if part:
                parts.append(part)
            current = []
            continue

        current.append(char)

    tail = "".join(current).strip()
    if tail:
        parts.append(tail)
    return parts


def _find_matching_paren(text: str, open_idx: int) -> int:
    depth = 0
    for idx in range(open_idx, len(text)):
        char = text[idx]
        if char == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif char == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return idx
    return -1


def _locate_module_interface(text: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, int]]]:
    module_match = re.search(r"\bmodule\s+([`\w$]+)", text)
    if not module_match:
        return None

    module_name = module_match.group(1)
    module_start = module_match.start()
    scan_idx = module_match.end()

    while True:
        scan_idx = len(text) if scan_idx >= len(text) else scan_idx
        scan_idx = len(text) if scan_idx < 0 else scan_idx
        scan_idx = scan_idx if scan_idx < len(text) else len(text)
        while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
            scan_idx += 1

        if text.startswith("import", scan_idx):
            semi_idx = text.find(";", scan_idx)
            if semi_idx < 0:
                return None
            scan_idx = semi_idx + 1
            continue
        break

    if scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx] == "#":
        hash_open = text.find("(", scan_idx)
        if hash_open < 0:
            return None
        hash_close = _find_matching_paren(text, hash_open)
        if hash_close < 0:
            return None
        scan_idx = hash_close + 1
        while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
            scan_idx += 1
        while text.startswith("import", scan_idx):
            semi_idx = text.find(";", scan_idx)
            if semi_idx < 0:
                return None
            scan_idx = semi_idx + 1
            while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
                scan_idx += 1

    open_idx = text.find("(", scan_idx)
    if open_idx < 0:
        return None

    close_idx = _find_matching_paren(text, open_idx)
    if close_idx < 0:
        return None

    semi_idx = text.find(";", close_idx)
    if semi_idx < 0:
        return None

    return {
        "module_name": module_name,
        "module_start": module_start,
        "module_open": open_idx,
        "module_close": close_idx,
        "module_semi": semi_idx,
        "port_block": text[open_idx + 1 : close_idx],
    }


def _locate_instantiation_block(text: str, inst_name: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, int]]]:
    inst_match = re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(inst_name)}\b\s*\(", text)
    if not inst_match:
        return None

    inst_start = inst_match.start()
    open_idx = text.find("(", inst_match.start())
    if open_idx < 0:
        return None
    close_idx = _find_matching_paren(text, open_idx)
    if close_idx < 0:
        return None
    return {
        "inst_start": inst_start,
        "inst_open": open_idx,
        "inst_close": close_idx,
        "conn_block": text[open_idx + 1 : close_idx],
    }


def _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_entry: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Parse one ANSI-style port declaration into name, direction, and width."""
    cleaned_entry = re.sub(r"//.*", "", port_entry).strip()
    cleaned_entry = re.sub(r"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", "", cleaned_entry).strip()
    if not cleaned_entry:
        return None

    direction_match = re.match(r"^(input|output|inout)\b", cleaned_entry)
    if not direction_match:
        return None

    direction = direction_match.group(1)
    identifiers = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*", cleaned_entry)
    if not identifiers:
        return None

    name = identifiers[-1]
    width_matches = re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]", cleaned_entry)
    width = " ".join(width_matches)
    return {
        "name": name,
        "direction": direction,
        "width": width,
    }


def _extract_name_token(text: str) -> str:
    matches = re.findall(r"`[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*", text)
    return matches[-1] if matches else ""


def _extract_non_ansi_decl_map(module: object) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
    decl_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
    members = getattr(module, "members", None) or []

    for member in members:
        raw = str(getattr(member, "rawText", "") or "")
        if not raw:
            continue
        cleaned = re.sub(r"//.*?$", "", raw, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", "", cleaned)
        cleaned = cleaned.strip()
        if not cleaned:
            continue

        direction_match = re.match(r"^(input|output|inout|ref)\b", cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if not direction_match:
            continue

        direction = direction_match.group(1).lower()
        rest = re.sub(r";\s*$", "", cleaned[direction_match.end() :].strip())
        if not rest:
            continue

        width_parts = re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]", rest)
        width = " ".join(width_parts)

        for entry in _split_top_level_commas(rest):
            name = _extract_name_token(entry)
            if not name:
                continue
            decl_map[name] = {"direction": direction, "width": width}

    return decl_map


def parse_module_interface(file_path: Path) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Parse module name and port declarations (ANSI and non-ANSI) using pyslang only."""
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return None

    tree = pyslang.SyntaxTree.fromFile(str(file_path))
    root = getattr(tree, "root", None)
    if root is None:
        return None

    members = getattr(root, "members", None)
    if members is None:
        return None

    module = None
    for member in members:
        if isinstance(member, pyslang.ModuleDeclarationSyntax):
            module = member
            break
    if module is None:
        return None

    header = getattr(module, "header", None)
    if header is None:
        return None

    module_name_tok = getattr(header, "name", None)
    module_name = str(getattr(module_name_tok, "value", "") or getattr(module_name_tok, "rawText", "") or "")
    if not module_name:
        return None

    ports_container = getattr(header, "ports", None)
    port_nodes = getattr(ports_container, "ports", None) if ports_container is not None else None
    if port_nodes is None:
        return {"module_name": module_name, "ports": [], "style": "unknown"}

    decl_map = _extract_non_ansi_decl_map(module)
    ports: List[Dict] = []
    style = "non-ansi"

    for port in port_nodes:
        port_text = str(getattr(port, "rawText", "") or "").strip()
        if not port_text:
            continue

        ansi_row = _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_text)
        if ansi_row is not None:
            style = "ansi"
            ports.append(ansi_row)
            continue

        name = _extract_name_token(port_text)
        if not name:
            continue
        decl = decl_map.get(name, {"direction": "unknown", "width": ""})
        ports.append(
            {
                "name": name,
                "direction": str(decl.get("direction", "unknown")),
                "width": str(decl.get("width", "")),
            }
        )

    return {
        "module_name": module_name,
        "ports": ports,
        "style": style,
    }


def parse_ansi_module_interface(file_path: Path) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Backward-compatible wrapper; now returns unified ANSI/non-ANSI interface parsed by pyslang."""
    return parse_module_interface(file_path)


def append_port(file_path: Path, signals: List[Union[Dict, Tuple, str]], c_like: bool = True) -> bool:
    """
    Append signals to module port list with optional direction and width.
    
    Supports two styles:
    
    1. C-style (c_like=True, default):
       Appends full declarations in the module port list:
       ,input [5:0] sys_link_capable
    
    2. Verilog-style (c_like=False):
       Appends signal names in port list: ,signal_name
       Then appends full declarations after the last signal in the declarations section:
       input [5:0] signal_name;
    
    Supports multiple input formats for signals:
    - dict: {"name": "signal_name", "direction": "input", "width": "[2:0]"}
           (direction and width are optional)
    - tuple: ("signal_name", "input", "[2:0]") or ("signal_name", "input")
    - str: "signal_name" (simple signal without direction/width)
    
    Args:
        file_path: Path to the file to modify
        signals: List of signal specifications
        c_like: If True (default), use C-style port declarations in module header.
                If False, use Verilog-style port names in header + declarations after last signal.
    
    Returns True if modification was made, False otherwise.
    """
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return False
    
    text = read_file_text(file_path)
    
    # Convert signals to standardized format
    signal_specs = []
    for sig in signals:
        if isinstance(sig, dict):
            name = sig.get("name")
            direction = sig.get("direction", "")
            width = sig.get("width", "")
            signal_specs.append((name, direction, width))
        elif isinstance(sig, tuple):
            if len(sig) == 3:
                signal_specs.append(sig)
            elif len(sig) == 2:
                signal_specs.append((sig[0], sig[1], ""))
            else:
                signal_specs.append((sig[0], "", ""))
        elif isinstance(sig, str):
            signal_specs.append((sig, "", ""))
    
    located = _locate_module_interface(text)
    if not located:
        return False

    module_start = int(located["module_start"])
    module_open_idx = int(located["module_open"])
    module_close_idx = int(located["module_close"])
    module_semi_idx = int(located["module_semi"])
    module_open = text[module_start : module_open_idx + 1]
    port_block = str(located["port_block"])
    module_close = text[module_close_idx : module_semi_idx + 1]

    def build_port_entry(name: str, direction: str, width: str) -> str:
        if direction and width:
            return f"{direction} {width} {name}"
        if direction:
            return f"{direction} {name}"
        if width:
            return f"{width} {name}"
        return name

    def build_decl_line(name: str, direction: str, width: str) -> str:
        if direction and width:
            return f"{direction} {width} {name};"
        if direction:
            return f"{direction} {name};"
        if width:
            return f"{width} {name};"
        return f"{name};"

    missing_specs = []
    for name, direction, width in signal_specs:
        if not name:
            continue
        if re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\b", port_block):
            continue
        missing_specs.append((name, direction, width))

    if not missing_specs:
        return False

    port_lines = port_block.splitlines()
    last_nonempty_line = next((line for line in reversed(port_lines) if line.strip()), "")
    line_indent = re.match(r"\s*", last_nonempty_line).group(0) if last_nonempty_line else ""

    if c_like:
        added_entries = [build_port_entry(name, direction, width) for name, direction, width in missing_specs]
        added_lines = [f"{line_indent},{entry}" for entry in added_entries]
        updated_ports = port_block.rstrip() + "\n" + "\n".join(added_lines)
        replacement = module_open + updated_ports + "\n" + module_close
        new_text = _apply_text_edits(text, [(module_start, module_semi_idx + 1, replacement)])
    else:
        added_names = [name for name, _, _ in missing_specs]
        added_lines = [f"{line_indent},{name}" for name in added_names]
        existing_port_lines = port_block.rstrip("\n").splitlines()
        if existing_port_lines:
            updated_port_lines = existing_port_lines + added_lines
            updated_ports = "\n".join(updated_port_lines)
        else:
            updated_ports = "\n".join(added_lines)
        replacement = module_open + updated_ports + "\n" + module_close

        existing_port_names = [
            token
            for token in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*", port_block)
        ]

        suffix = text[module_semi_idx + 1 :]
        decl_insert_rel = 0
        if existing_port_names:
            last_port_name = existing_port_names[-1]
            decl_pattern = re.compile(
                rf"^\s*(input|output|inout)\b[^\n]*\b{re.escape(last_port_name)}\b[^\n]*[;；][ \t\r]*$",
                re.MULTILINE,
            )
            decl_match = decl_pattern.search(suffix)
            if decl_match:
                decl_insert_rel = decl_match.end()

        prefix = text[:module_start]
        base_text = prefix + replacement + suffix
        insert_pos = len(prefix) + len(replacement) + decl_insert_rel

        decl_block = "\n" + "\n".join(
            build_decl_line(name, direction, width) for name, direction, width in missing_specs
        ) + "\n"
        new_text = base_text[:insert_pos] + decl_block + base_text[insert_pos:]

    write_file_text(file_path, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return True


def append_pin(file_path: Path, inst_name: str, pins: List[Tuple[str, str]]) -> bool:
    """
    Append port connections to instance instantiation, one pin per line with leading comma and dot.
    Finds "INSTNAME (...)" and adds port connections before ");".
    pins is a list of tuples like [("sys_fast_link_mode", "sys_fast_link_mode"), 
                                     ("sys_link_capable", "sys_link_capable")]
    which will be added one per line as "\n,.sys_fast_link_mode(sys_fast_link_mode)".
    Returns True if modification was made, False otherwise.
    """
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return False
    
    text = read_file_text(file_path)
    located = _locate_instantiation_block(text, inst_name)
    if not located:
        return False

    inst_start = int(located["inst_start"])
    inst_open = int(located["inst_open"])
    inst_close = int(located["inst_close"])
    conn_block = str(located["conn_block"])

    missing_pins = []
    for port_name, signal_name in pins:
        if re.search(rf"\.\s*{re.escape(port_name)}\s*\(", conn_block):
            continue
        missing_pins.append((port_name, signal_name))

    if not missing_pins:
        return False

    pin_strs = [f"{port_name}({signal_name})" for port_name, signal_name in missing_pins]
    updated_conns = conn_block.rstrip() + "\n,." + "\n,.".join(pin_strs)
    replacement = text[inst_start : inst_open + 1] + updated_conns + "\n" + text[inst_close:]
    new_text = _apply_text_edits(text, [(inst_start, len(text), replacement)])
    write_file_text(file_path, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return True


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Example usage
    import sys
    
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: module_append_utils.py <command> [options]")
        print("Commands:")
        print("  append_port <file> <signal1> [<signal2> ...] [--c-like yes|no]")
        print("  append_pin <file> <inst_name> <port1:sig1> [<port2:sig2> ...] ")
        sys.exit(1)

"""Utilities for appending ports and pins to Verilog files."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union


ENCODING = "utf-8"
pyslang = importlib.import_module("pyslang")


def read_file_text(path: Path) -> str:
    """Read file with standard encoding."""
    return path.read_text(encoding=ENCODING)


def write_file_text(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
    """Write file with standard encoding and newline."""
    path.write_text(content + "\n", encoding=ENCODING)


def _apply_text_edits(text: str, edits: List[Tuple[int, int, str]]) -> str:
    if not edits:
        return text
    ordered = sorted(edits, key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]), reverse=True)
    updated = text
    for start, end, replacement in ordered:
        if start < 0 or end < start or end > len(updated):
            raise ValueError("Invalid text edit range")
        updated = updated[:start] + replacement + updated[end:]
    return updated


def _split_top_level_commas(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Split a block on top-level commas while preserving bracketed expressions."""
    parts: List[str] = []
    current: List[str] = []
    paren_depth = 0
    bracket_depth = 0
    brace_depth = 0

    for char in text:
        if char == "(" :
            paren_depth += 1
        elif char == ")" and paren_depth > 0:
            paren_depth -= 1
        elif char == "[":
            bracket_depth += 1
        elif char == "]" and bracket_depth > 0:
            bracket_depth -= 1
        elif char == "{":
            brace_depth += 1
        elif char == "}" and brace_depth > 0:
            brace_depth -= 1

        if char == "," and paren_depth == 0 and bracket_depth == 0 and brace_depth == 0:
            part = "".join(current).strip()
            if part:
                parts.append(part)
            current = []
            continue

        current.append(char)

    tail = "".join(current).strip()
    if tail:
        parts.append(tail)
    return parts


def _find_matching_paren(text: str, open_idx: int) -> int:
    depth = 0
    for idx in range(open_idx, len(text)):
        char = text[idx]
        if char == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif char == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return idx
    return -1


def _locate_module_interface(text: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, int]]]:
    module_match = re.search(r"\bmodule\s+([`\w$]+)", text)
    if not module_match:
        return None

    module_name = module_match.group(1)
    module_start = module_match.start()
    scan_idx = module_match.end()

    while True:
        scan_idx = len(text) if scan_idx >= len(text) else scan_idx
        scan_idx = len(text) if scan_idx < 0 else scan_idx
        scan_idx = scan_idx if scan_idx < len(text) else len(text)
        while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
            scan_idx += 1

        if text.startswith("import", scan_idx):
            semi_idx = text.find(";", scan_idx)
            if semi_idx < 0:
                return None
            scan_idx = semi_idx + 1
            continue
        break

    if scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx] == "#":
        hash_open = text.find("(", scan_idx)
        if hash_open < 0:
            return None
        hash_close = _find_matching_paren(text, hash_open)
        if hash_close < 0:
            return None
        scan_idx = hash_close + 1
        while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
            scan_idx += 1
        while text.startswith("import", scan_idx):
            semi_idx = text.find(";", scan_idx)
            if semi_idx < 0:
                return None
            scan_idx = semi_idx + 1
            while scan_idx < len(text) and text[scan_idx].isspace():
                scan_idx += 1

    open_idx = text.find("(", scan_idx)
    if open_idx < 0:
        return None

    close_idx = _find_matching_paren(text, open_idx)
    if close_idx < 0:
        return None

    semi_idx = text.find(";", close_idx)
    if semi_idx < 0:
        return None

    return {
        "module_name": module_name,
        "module_start": module_start,
        "module_open": open_idx,
        "module_close": close_idx,
        "module_semi": semi_idx,
        "port_block": text[open_idx + 1 : close_idx],
    }


def _locate_instantiation_block(text: str, inst_name: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, int]]]:
    inst_match = re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(inst_name)}\b\s*\(", text)
    if not inst_match:
        return None

    inst_start = inst_match.start()
    open_idx = text.find("(", inst_match.start())
    if open_idx < 0:
        return None
    close_idx = _find_matching_paren(text, open_idx)
    if close_idx < 0:
        return None
    return {
        "inst_start": inst_start,
        "inst_open": open_idx,
        "inst_close": close_idx,
        "conn_block": text[open_idx + 1 : close_idx],
    }


def _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_entry: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Parse one ANSI-style port declaration into name, direction, and width."""
    cleaned_entry = re.sub(r"//.*", "", port_entry).strip()
    cleaned_entry = re.sub(r"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", "", cleaned_entry).strip()
    if not cleaned_entry:
        return None

    direction_match = re.match(r"^(input|output|inout)\b", cleaned_entry)
    if not direction_match:
        return None

    direction = direction_match.group(1)
    identifiers = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*", cleaned_entry)
    if not identifiers:
        return None

    name = identifiers[-1]
    width_matches = re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]", cleaned_entry)
    width = " ".join(width_matches)
    return {
        "name": name,
        "direction": direction,
        "width": width,
    }


def _extract_name_token(text: str) -> str:
    matches = re.findall(r"`[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*", text)
    return matches[-1] if matches else ""


def _extract_non_ansi_decl_map(module: object) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
    decl_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
    members = getattr(module, "members", None) or []

    for member in members:
        raw = str(getattr(member, "rawText", "") or "")
        if not raw:
            continue
        cleaned = re.sub(r"//.*?$", "", raw, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", "", cleaned)
        cleaned = cleaned.strip()
        if not cleaned:
            continue

        direction_match = re.match(r"^(input|output|inout|ref)\b", cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if not direction_match:
            continue

        direction = direction_match.group(1).lower()
        rest = re.sub(r";\s*$", "", cleaned[direction_match.end() :].strip())
        if not rest:
            continue

        width_parts = re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]", rest)
        width = " ".join(width_parts)

        for entry in _split_top_level_commas(rest):
            name = _extract_name_token(entry)
            if not name:
                continue
            decl_map[name] = {"direction": direction, "width": width}

    return decl_map


def _extract_header_port_names_from_module_text(module_text: str, module_name: str) -> List[str]:
    name_idx = module_text.find(module_name)
    if name_idx < 0:
        return []

    scan_idx = name_idx + len(module_name)
    while scan_idx < len(module_text) and module_text[scan_idx].isspace():
        scan_idx += 1

    if scan_idx < len(module_text) and module_text[scan_idx] == "#":
        hash_open = module_text.find("(", scan_idx)
        if hash_open < 0:
            return []
        hash_close = _find_matching_paren(module_text, hash_open)
        if hash_close < 0:
            return []
        scan_idx = hash_close + 1

    open_idx = module_text.find("(", scan_idx)
    if open_idx < 0:
        return []
    close_idx = _find_matching_paren(module_text, open_idx)
    if close_idx < 0:
        return []

    port_block = module_text[open_idx + 1 : close_idx]
    names: List[str] = []
    for entry in _split_top_level_commas(port_block):
        name = _extract_name_token(entry)
        if name:
            names.append(name)
    return names


def parse_module_interface(file_path: Path) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Parse module name and port declarations (ANSI and non-ANSI) using pyslang only."""
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return None

    tree = pyslang.SyntaxTree.fromFile(str(file_path))
    root = getattr(tree, "root", None)
    if root is None:
        return None

    members = getattr(root, "members", None)
    if members is None:
        return None

    module = None
    for member in members:
        if isinstance(member, pyslang.ModuleDeclarationSyntax):
            module = member
            break
    if module is None:
        return None

    header = getattr(module, "header", None)
    if header is None:
        return None

    module_name_tok = getattr(header, "name", None)
    module_name = str(getattr(module_name_tok, "value", "") or getattr(module_name_tok, "rawText", "") or "")
    if not module_name:
        return None

    module_range = getattr(module, "sourceRange", None)
    module_start = getattr(getattr(module_range, "start", None), "offset", None) if module_range is not None else None
    module_end = getattr(getattr(module_range, "end", None), "offset", None) if module_range is not None else None
    source_text = read_file_text(file_path)
    module_text = source_text[module_start:module_end] if module_start is not None and module_end is not None else ""

    ports_container = getattr(header, "ports", None)
    port_nodes = getattr(ports_container, "ports", None) if ports_container is not None else None
    decl_map = _extract_non_ansi_decl_map(module)
    ports: List[Dict] = []
    style = "unknown"

    if port_nodes is not None:
        style = "non-ansi"
        for port in port_nodes:
            port_text = str(getattr(port, "rawText", "") or "").strip()
            if not port_text:
                continue

            ansi_row = _parse_ansi_port_entry(port_text)
            if ansi_row is not None:
                style = "ansi"
                ports.append(ansi_row)
                continue

            name = _extract_name_token(port_text)
            if not name:
                continue
            decl = decl_map.get(name, {"direction": "unknown", "width": ""})
            ports.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "direction": str(decl.get("direction", "unknown")),
                    "width": str(decl.get("width", "")),
                }
            )

    if not ports and module_text:
        style = "non-ansi"
        for name in _extract_header_port_names_from_module_text(module_text, module_name):
            decl = decl_map.get(name, {"direction": "unknown", "width": ""})
            ports.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "direction": str(decl.get("direction", "unknown")),
                    "width": str(decl.get("width", "")),
                }
            )

    return {
        "module_name": module_name,
        "ports": ports,
        "style": style,
    }


def parse_ansi_module_interface(file_path: Path) -> Optional[Dict]:
    """Backward-compatible wrapper; now returns unified ANSI/non-ANSI interface parsed by pyslang."""
    return parse_module_interface(file_path)


def append_port(file_path: Path, signals: List[Union[Dict, Tuple, str]], c_like: bool = True) -> bool:
    """
    Append signals to module port list with optional direction and width.
    
    Supports two styles:
    
    1. C-style (c_like=True, default):
       Appends full declarations in the module port list:
       ,input [5:0] sys_link_capable
    
    2. Verilog-style (c_like=False):
       Appends signal names in port list: ,signal_name
       Then appends full declarations after the last signal in the declarations section:
       input [5:0] signal_name;
    
    Supports multiple input formats for signals:
    - dict: {"name": "signal_name", "direction": "input", "width": "[2:0]"}
           (direction and width are optional)
    - tuple: ("signal_name", "input", "[2:0]") or ("signal_name", "input")
    - str: "signal_name" (simple signal without direction/width)
    
    Args:
        file_path: Path to the file to modify
        signals: List of signal specifications
        c_like: If True (default), use C-style port declarations in module header.
                If False, use Verilog-style port names in header + declarations after last signal.
    
    Returns True if modification was made, False otherwise.
    """
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return False
    
    text = read_file_text(file_path)
    
    # Convert signals to standardized format
    signal_specs = []
    for sig in signals:
        if isinstance(sig, dict):
            name = sig.get("name")
            direction = sig.get("direction", "")
            width = sig.get("width", "")
            signal_specs.append((name, direction, width))
        elif isinstance(sig, tuple):
            if len(sig) == 3:
                signal_specs.append(sig)
            elif len(sig) == 2:
                signal_specs.append((sig[0], sig[1], ""))
            else:
                signal_specs.append((sig[0], "", ""))
        elif isinstance(sig, str):
            signal_specs.append((sig, "", ""))
    
    located = _locate_module_interface(text)
    if not located:
        return False

    module_start = int(located["module_start"])
    module_open_idx = int(located["module_open"])
    module_close_idx = int(located["module_close"])
    module_semi_idx = int(located["module_semi"])
    module_open = text[module_start : module_open_idx + 1]
    port_block = str(located["port_block"])
    module_close = text[module_close_idx : module_semi_idx + 1]

    def build_port_entry(name: str, direction: str, width: str) -> str:
        if direction and width:
            return f"{direction} {width} {name}"
        if direction:
            return f"{direction} {name}"
        if width:
            return f"{width} {name}"
        return name

    def build_decl_line(name: str, direction: str, width: str) -> str:
        if direction and width:
            return f"{direction} {width} {name};"
        if direction:
            return f"{direction} {name};"
        if width:
            return f"{width} {name};"
        return f"{name};"

    missing_specs = []
    for name, direction, width in signal_specs:
        if not name:
            continue
        if re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\b", port_block):
            continue
        missing_specs.append((name, direction, width))

    if not missing_specs:
        return False

    port_lines = port_block.splitlines()
    last_nonempty_line = next((line for line in reversed(port_lines) if line.strip()), "")
    line_indent = re.match(r"\s*", last_nonempty_line).group(0) if last_nonempty_line else ""

    if c_like:
        added_entries = [build_port_entry(name, direction, width) for name, direction, width in missing_specs]
        added_lines = [f"{line_indent},{entry}" for entry in added_entries]
        updated_ports = port_block.rstrip() + "\n" + "\n".join(added_lines)
        replacement = module_open + updated_ports + "\n" + module_close
        new_text = _apply_text_edits(text, [(module_start, module_semi_idx + 1, replacement)])
    else:
        added_names = [name for name, _, _ in missing_specs]
        added_lines = [f"{line_indent},{name}" for name in added_names]
        existing_port_lines = port_block.rstrip("\n").splitlines()
        if existing_port_lines:
            updated_port_lines = existing_port_lines + added_lines
            updated_ports = "\n".join(updated_port_lines)
        else:
            updated_ports = "\n".join(added_lines)
        replacement = module_open + updated_ports + "\n" + module_close

        existing_port_names = [
            token
            for token in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*", port_block)
        ]

        suffix = text[module_semi_idx + 1 :]
        decl_insert_rel = 0
        if existing_port_names:
            last_port_name = existing_port_names[-1]
            decl_pattern = re.compile(
                rf"^\s*(input|output|inout)\b[^\n]*\b{re.escape(last_port_name)}\b[^\n]*[;；][ \t\r]*$",
                re.MULTILINE,
            )
            decl_match = decl_pattern.search(suffix)
            if decl_match:
                decl_insert_rel = decl_match.end()

        prefix = text[:module_start]
        base_text = prefix + replacement + suffix
        insert_pos = len(prefix) + len(replacement) + decl_insert_rel

        decl_block = "\n" + "\n".join(
            build_decl_line(name, direction, width) for name, direction, width in missing_specs
        ) + "\n"
        new_text = base_text[:insert_pos] + decl_block + base_text[insert_pos:]

    write_file_text(file_path, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return True


def append_pin(file_path: Path, inst_name: str, pins: List[Tuple[str, str]]) -> bool:
    """
    Append port connections to instance instantiation, one pin per line with leading comma and dot.
    Finds "INSTNAME (...)" and adds port connections before ");".
    pins is a list of tuples like [("sys_fast_link_mode", "sys_fast_link_mode"), 
                                     ("sys_link_capable", "sys_link_capable")]
    which will be added one per line as "\n,.sys_fast_link_mode(sys_fast_link_mode)".
    Returns True if modification was made, False otherwise.
    """
    if not file_path.is_file():
        return False
    
    text = read_file_text(file_path)
    located = _locate_instantiation_block(text, inst_name)
    if not located:
        return False

    inst_start = int(located["inst_start"])
    inst_open = int(located["inst_open"])
    inst_close = int(located["inst_close"])
    conn_block = str(located["conn_block"])

    missing_pins = []
    for port_name, signal_name in pins:
        if re.search(rf"\.\s*{re.escape(port_name)}\s*\(", conn_block):
            continue
        missing_pins.append((port_name, signal_name))

    if not missing_pins:
        return False

    pin_strs = [f"{port_name}({signal_name})" for port_name, signal_name in missing_pins]
    updated_conns = conn_block.rstrip() + "\n,." + "\n,.".join(pin_strs)
    replacement = text[inst_start : inst_open + 1] + updated_conns + "\n" + text[inst_close:]
    new_text = _apply_text_edits(text, [(inst_start, len(text), replacement)])
    write_file_text(file_path, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return True


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Example usage
    import sys
    
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: module_append_utils.py <command> [options]")
        print("Commands:")
        print("  append_port <file> <signal1> [<signal2> ...] [--c-like yes|no]")
        print("  append_pin <file> <inst_name> <port1:sig1> [<port2:sig2> ...] ")
        sys.exit(1)
